text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(—Running in pure exhilaration taught me 
something.)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I still can't catch up. I have to run 
more, so much more...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to win. Because in the end, 
heroes are the ones who triumph...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(They possess tenacity. They make no 
effort to hide their desire for victory.)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(That is what makes them strong. For the 
sake of victory, they can dig deep for 
that very last step.)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(I want to surpass them all as they pursue 
their own righteousness, and become number 
one.)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(I want to show my parents—— that I became 
number one in this strongest era!)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: —A request for a feature on me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As she returned, making no attempt to hide 
her fighting spirit, I informed her that a 
reporter had requested an interview.
choice_data_list:
The working title is 'A Flash That 
Glitters in the Age of the Strongest'!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's certainly a straightforward 
name. I think it's wonderful. However...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I have no intention of ending as just a 
"flash." I will keep shining until the 
very end.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Once I've done what needs to be done— 
I am also considering retirement.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing the word "final," I felt that the 
end we had set together was drawing near.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
choice_data_list:
...Let's give it our all in the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)!

...Let's give it our all in the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The time has finally come... to fulfill my 
goal. I will—without fail—win the Tenno 
Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And after that..."—Seeing the spirited 
look on Eishin Flash's face, I swallowed 
the rest of my words.
